badges.rarityFormula: The TBRI v2 combines six signals: owner scarcity (40%), wear rate (10%), obtainability (20%), age (10%), 24h momentum from potat.app (10%) and claim-window brevity (10%) — a 0–100 score mapped to six tiers. Badges that require buying a ticket (TwitchCon & co.) are always legendary.
